topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: I wandered through the yard sale, the sun a little too bright, the world a little too loud. My fingers traced the edges of old books and pottery, items whispering tales of times past. Then, nestled between a set of chipped teacups and a stack of vinyl records, I saw him. Teddy, my old bear, with his one patchy ear and mismatched button eyes. His fur, once golden, now faded, still held the faint scent of my childhood room. I picked him up, feeling the same softness that used to comfort me during my darkest fears. The crowd seemed to blur, the voices of strangers blending into a soft hum. I brought Teddy to my chest, the world quieting just a bit, as if by holding him, I could hold on to something that felt just right, for once.
